convert_groundingdino_checkpoint_to_mmde: convert a GroundingDINO checkpoint to mmdet format by renaming keys and reshaping tensors
run_checkpoint_converter_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a GroundingDINO checkpoint file to mmdet style and save it
correct_unfold_reduction_order: correct the reduction tensor order by reshaping and reordering channels for downsample layers
correct_unfold_norm_order: correct the normalization tensor order by reshaping and reordering channels for norm layers
rename_backbone_keys: rename backbone layer keys from GroundingDINO naming to mmdet naming convention including stages and ffn
